```python
def is_palindrome(lst):
    """
    Check if the list is palindromic (reads the same forwards and backwards)
    """
    return lst == lst[::-1]

def will_it_fly(q, w):
    """
    Returns True if the object q will fly, and False otherwise.
    """
    if not is_palindrome(q):
        return False
    total = sum(q)
    return total <= w
```
